summary.text: Dave Bronson is a Republican retired Air National Guard officer and pilot who served as mayor of Anchorage from 2021 to 2024 and later managed Ted Stevens Anchorage International Airport. He supports a constitutional amendment mandating Permanent Fund dividends by the pre-2017 formula and describes data centers as an economic opportunity.

paragraphs.text: Born in Superior, Wisconsin; B.S. in agricultural economics from the University of Wisconsin–Madison.
Served in the U.S. Air Force (1981–1990) and Alaska Air National Guard (1993–2005), retiring as a lieutenant colonel; worked as a commercial pilot from 1990.
Elected Anchorage mayor in a May 2021 runoff, serving until 2024; later managed Ted Stevens Anchorage International Airport and announced his resignation in August 2025.
